new file mode 100644

--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/refunds/signature.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+import { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } from "node:crypto"
+
+export type Check = { ok: true } | { ok: false; reason: string }
+
+/** `t=<unix>,v1=<hex hmac>` as Stripe sends it. */
+export function verifySignature(raw: string, header: string, secret: string, toleranceSeconds: number): Check {
+  const parts = Object.fromEntries(header.split(",").map((p) => p.split("=") as [string, string]))
+  const t = Number(parts.t)
+  if (!parts.v1 || !Number.isFinite(t)) return { ok: false, reason: "malformed signature header" }
+  if (Math.abs(Date.now() / 1000 - t) > toleranceSeconds) return { ok: false, reason: "stale event" }
+  const want = createHmac("sha256", secret).update(`${t}.${raw}`).digest()
+  const got = Buffer.from(parts.v1, "hex")
+  if (got.length !== want.length || !timingSafeEqual(got, want)) return { ok: false, reason: "bad signature" }
+  return { ok: true }
+}

+## Idempotency keys
+
+Send an `Idempotency-Key` header on every `POST`. We store the first response
+for 24 hours and replay it for any request that repeats the key, so a retry
+after a timeout never charges twice.
+
+- Use a fresh random key per logical operation (a UUID is fine).
+- Reusing a key with a different body returns `422 idempotency_mismatch`.
+- Keys are scoped to your API key, not to the endpoint.
+
 Errors are JSON: `{ "error": { "code": "...", "message": "..." } }`.
